messages.author: Seibold, Steve Allan
messages.body:
Hello
I am running AMBER16 on a Ubuntu 16.04. I am running on  CUDA 10.0 with a driver version: 415.27. Someone did compile AMBER16 with this set-up. However, I need to upgrade my CUDA  to 10.1 and my driver version to 418.39. My question is, will I have to re-compile AMBER16?
Thanks, Steve
